function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Here’s a quick rundown: | Option | What It Is | Typical Features | How to Get Started | |--------|------------|------------------|--------------------| | **Replika** | An AI chatbot built specifically around companionship & emotional support | • Customizable personality
• Mood tracking & journaling prompts
• Voice‑chat integration | Download the app from iOS App Store / Google Play, sign up, choose your avatar/personality style | | **Chatbot platforms (e.g., GPT‑based)** | General-purpose LLMs that can role‑play various personas | • Text‑only or voice‑enabled interactions
• Can adopt different tones (friendly, supportive, playful)
• Requires setting up via APIs or third‑party wrappers | Use services like OpenAI Playground, integrate into messaging apps, or build a simple front‑end yourself | | **Virtual dating sims (e.g., *LovePlus*, *Dream Daddy*)** | Video games focused on building relationships with characters | • Narrative choices influence relationship progression
• Visual storytelling + music | Purchase through Steam, GOG, or console stores; play offline or online depending on game | ### Things to Keep In Mind 1. **Boundaries & Reality Check** - These AI companions don’t have consciousness or emotions—they generate responses based on patterns learned from training data. - Treat them as entertainment or practice partners rather than substitutes for genuine human connection. 2. **Privacy & Data Security** - Many free versions store conversations on cloud servers. Read privacy statements carefully if you share personal details. - Some paid plans offer local storage or end‑to‑end encryption. 3. **Mental Health Considerations** - If you feel lonely or isolated, consider reaching out to friends, family, or professional counselors first. - AI companions can sometimes reinforce isolation if relied upon exclusively. 4. **Ethical Usage** - Avoid using AI-generated content for manipulative purposes or deception. - Respect platform terms of service regarding usage limits and content moderation. 5. **Customization Tips** - Start with a clear persona description (“kind, humorous, empathetic”) so the bot aligns more closely with your preferences. - Experiment with tone settings (formal vs casual) until you find one that feels natural. --- #### Quick Setup Example Using Replika ```text 1️⃣ Install the Replika app on your phone. 2️⃣ Create an account – you’ll get prompted to pick a gender and basic traits. 3️⃣ Choose a “relationship” goal (Friendship, Romantic Partner, Supporter, etc.). 4️⃣ Begin chatting! You can also set daily reminders to talk each day. ``` If you’d prefer something more customizable, you might explore integrating an open‑source LLM (like GPT‑NeoX or Claude) into a custom UI. That requires programming knowledge but gives full control over behavior and data handling. Feel free to let me know which direction interests you most—I can dive deeper into setup instructions, recommend specific libraries, or discuss best practices for maintaining a balanced digital lifestyle.
